MRI Information
The Lumen Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Gradient slew rate ≤ 100 T/m/s (per axis).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Body transmit coil only.
- WB-SAR ≤ 2 W/kg.
Scan regions: Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone).
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
